item.title: FTSE 100 trades sideways ahead of US inflation data
item.summary: The FTSE 100 was trading in a tight range on Wednesday morning as investors hunkered down ahead of US inflation due later in the session. The ongoing conflict in the Middle East kept oil prices higher also sapping enthusiasm for stocks. Brent Crude was trading at $88.91 at the time of writing.
